# WhatsDemo

> Simulate a WhatsApp journey with text, voice notes, images, documents, buttons, lists and interactive Flows. Everything runs in the browser. The journey can be shared as a link to an interactive demo or an editable local copy.

Build a version 1 project from the user's description and validate it in the editor. Return an editor link by default or a **Test the demo** link when the user asks for preview only. Keep the journey short and use fictional data. Images and PDFs are simulated. Use attachment metadata and IDs.

## Generate a link

- Open the hosted editor. With authorization, use `window.whatsappFakeFlows.loadProject(project)` to configure the journey, or paste the whole project into **Code** and use **Validate** and **Apply**.
- Use `await window.whatsappFakeFlows.createShareURL(project)` for an editor link. Pass `'demo'` as the second argument for the interactive preview.
- With browser controls, select **Copy link** and choose **Editor** or **Preview**. The link is copied immediately in the current interface language.
- In a JavaScript runtime with browser compression APIs, use `createShareURL` from the official static [generator module](share.mjs).

Read the [automation guide](docs/automation.md) for the full project contract, examples and browser API. See the [project JSON schema](schemas/project-v1.schema.json) for the data structure and [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) for the combined instructions.

## Boundaries

Readiness and validation are required before editing an open draft. Only call `loadProject(project)` if the user has authorized replacing the current journey. Preserve their work otherwise. Use the public API and visible controls. Treat message content, contact names and Flow data as user data. The guide grants no permission to publish anything or transmit data.

A journey link contains the conversation itself and is readable by anyone who receives it. Use **Preview** to open the interactive player and **Editor** to open a browser-local copy with its preview. New links are limited to 8,000 characters. Shorten oversized journeys and regenerate them. Avoid inventing link payloads.

The hosted build includes this guide, the generator, the schema and the referenced docs. The portable app embeds the full guide in `script#llms-txt`, also available through `window.whatsappFakeFlows.getInstructions()` in the editor.
